{{Quote|Tinians believed all language could be reduced to touch. Their skin was so sensitive.|Kleya Marki discussing the Tinians while showing the Tinian Codex to Lonni Jung|<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />}}
The '''Tinians''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] species that existed on a [[Unidentified Tinian planet|planet]] in [[the galaxy]]. They had very sensitive skin and considered blindness to be a gift and sight to be a disability.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> Around [[2000 BBY]],<ref name="Codex date">During the events of "[[What a Festive Evening]]" which "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates to [[3 BBY]], [[Kleya Marki]] states that the Tinian Codex was forged 2000 [[Standard year|years]] ago placing its correction around [[2000 BBY]]</ref> the Tinians forged the [[Tinian Codex]], a stone carving with metal inlay which could be read by touch.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Episode Date">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" established that the events of "[[What a Festive Evening]]" take place during [[3 BBY]].</ref> while at a [[Senate Investiture]] [[Davo Sculdun's party|party]], [[Kleya Marki]] briefly described the Tinians while removing a [[listening device]] from the Tinian Codex.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Tinians were first mentioned in the [[What a Festive Evening|sixth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
